verdict.rationale: Git Sync connects Insomnia directly to any third-party Git repository without going through the cloud, and project data stays in your repo. Projects can be converted to Git Sync storage, and an in-app merge view handles conflict resolution. Insomnia YAML (v5) is a documented text format, which suggests repo-stored collections are plain text, though the docs never say outright that Git Sync writes YAML files. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Git Sync stores collections as plain-text YAML files in the repo, independent or hands-on corroboration of the git workflow.
